story.title: Prabhas’ ‘Spirit’ gets Diwali 2027 release date, set to clash with ‘Ramayana 2’
story.summary: Sandeep Reddy Vanga announced a new release date for his film 'Spirit' starring Prabhas. The film is now scheduled for release on October 29, 2027, during the Diwali period. This change may lead to a box-office clash with 'Ramayana 2', featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, also set for that date. 'Spirit' marks the first collaboration between Vanga and Prabhas, featuring a notable cast.

story.title: FWICEcondemns firing at Tiger Shroff; seeks security for actor
story.summary: The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) on Sunday strongly condemned the firing incident involving Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff's vehicle and called for immediate security measures to ensure the safety of the actor and his family.
